meta.title: Interactive Video Generator: AI Video That Answers Back
meta.description: An interactive video generator changes the story as you type, vote, or click. How interactive AI video works, plus the live channels where you can steer it.

h1: Interactive video generators: you type, the video answers

faqs.q: How is interactive AI video different from a chatbot with a face?
faqs.a: A chatbot answers with text or speech. Interactive AI video answers with new *footage*: your input is turned into the next scene of a running video stream, generated live by a video model.

faqs.q: Does my vote actually change the video?
faqs.a: On audience-voting channels, yes — the top-voted suggestion becomes the instruction for the next scene, and you watch it render within seconds. On Infinite Slop and Renoise Live, the show is visibly built from viewer decisions.

faqs.q: Can one person steer, or does the crowd decide?
faqs.a: On live channels the crowd decides — proposals go to a vote and the winner screens. Running your own channel (or a self-hosted stack) gives a single director full control.
